name: Exponential Approximation Method
definition: A ray-marching method for volumetric rendering that uses an exponential approximation for transmittance and alpha compositing along rays.
summary: The Exponential Approximation Method is a volume ray casting technique that approximates light attenuation using discrete steps and an exponential transmittance model, differing from linear alpha compositing by scaling alpha values with a step-size-dependent correction factor.
